tasks.title: Author the test-report contract and validator
tasks.description: Add contracts/schemas/v1/test-report.schema.json (required: schema_version const 1.0, project, generated_at date-time, command, tests_total, tests_passed, tests_failed, tests_skipped; counts integer minimum 0; additionalProperties false; enum-free). Add validateTestReport to cli/lib/validate.js (mirroring validateBuildReport), export it, import it in cli/appbuilder.js and add it to module.exports, and append 'test-report' to REQUIRED_SCHEMA_NAMES. Test-first: add validateTestReport unit tests (valid report passes; missing/!=0-count report fails).
acceptance_criteria: test-report.schema.json validates the eight required fields with enum-free, integer-minimum-0 counts.
validateTestReport is exported from cli/lib/validate.js and re-exported from cli/appbuilder.js.

tasks.title: Implement the test verb (run, gate, report)
tasks.description: Add cli/lib/test.js exporting test(cwd, args): resolve build/<slug>/, fail if build-report.json is absent, spawn `node --test` over the project's test glob in build/<slug>/, parse the summary lines for counts, and gate on build-report present + >=1 test + zero failures. On failure print the captured output and a `fail test:` line, exit 1, write nothing (including the zero-tests case -> 'no tests found'). On pass build and validate a test-report.json then write build/<slug>/test-report.json. Wire `case test` in cli/appbuilder.js out of the start/test/review/ship placeholder group, and add a Test section to the help text. Test-first: happy path (scaffold cli -> build -> test passes, report counts + schema valid) and gate reds (missing build-report; a failing test writes no report; zero tests writes no report).
acceptance_criteria: `appbuilder test <slug>` runs node --test in build/<slug>/ and exits non-zero on any test failure, missing build-report, or zero tests.
On success it writes a schema-valid build/<slug>/test-report.json with accurate counts and the exact command; on any failure it writes nothing.
test is routed as its own command and removed from the placeholder group; help text documents it.

tasks.title: Document the test phase for operators
tasks.description: Add a Test section to README.md (the verb, what the gate checks, link to HOWTO) and a thorough test-phase walkthrough to HOWTO.md after the Build section (the verb, the gate rules, the test-report.json, a failure-mode -> fix table), renumbering the subsequent sections. Update the 'Later phases' note to drop test. Drop test from any 'start/test/review/ship are placeholders' wording. Docs only.
acceptance_criteria: HOWTO.md has a thorough test-phase walkthrough with the gate rules and a failure-mode table; later sections renumbered.
README.md has a Test section; 'later phases' wording lists only start/review/ship.
doctor stays green (no broken plan-interview/onboarding references).
